listenings.text: Good morning. Welcome to your first Fellowship meeting. My name is Peter Lang, and I am your group coordinator. In your group there are six people, from five countries. Your partner for the first month is Marina Alves, from Recife. Her project is about technology in small schools. Our meetings are on Tuesday. Please read your group's document before the call. Their questions are at the end of the page. Thank you, and welcome.

Hello, this is a message from the university. Our director sends her best wishes to the new group. The professor of the research program is Doctor Klein. His office is on the second floor, and his email is at the end of this message. Marina's report is ready, and it is in your group folder. If you need our team, please write to us. Our answer is always in two days. Thank you very much.

reading.rtitle: Google Fellowship -- Welcome to Your Group
paras: Dear Joice, welcome to your group. Our program connects education leaders from Brazil and Latin America, and your group is one of six.
Your coordinator is Peter Lang. His office is in São Paulo, and his email is at the end of this message. Peter's job is to help your group every week.
Your partner is Marina Alves, from Recife. She is a researcher. Her project is about technology in small schools, and her university is in the northeast of Brazil.
Our first meeting is on Tuesday. Please read the group's document before the call. Their questions are at the end of the page.
